# kcp-triage

> Automatic agentic web service discovery — crawls and classifies websites,
> then builds KCP knowledge.yaml manifests so LLM agents can interact with them.

Each triaged site gets an agent-ready workbench: CLAUDE.md, skills, API inventory,
unknown-endpoints list, and a KCP manifest. Two-layer architecture: Builder (src/)
produces Sites (sites/<domain>/).

Part of the [KCP ecosystem](https://github.com/Cantara/knowledge-context-protocol).
Apache-2.0. TypeScript / Bun.

## Structured Navigation (for AI agents)

This repository ships a KCP v0.14 manifest:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cantara/kcp-triage/main/knowledge.yaml

Signing key (delegated to Cantara org): https://wiki.cantara.no/.well-known/kcp-signing-key.pub

## Key Files

- [README.md](README.md) — Architecture, install, how to triage a site
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — Agent context, skills, codebase conventions
- [src/](src/) — Builder pipeline: crawlers, classifiers, generators, orchestration

## Install

```bash
bun install
bun run src/cli.ts triage example.com
```
